notes.text: Scope (observation #57): (1) diff over DIFF_LIMIT=15000 -> send per-file chunks or raise the limit; never a silent cut that hides files. (2) reviewer runs tools-off (agy/gemini spawned `find /` and unittest in the worktree). (3) review timeout (exit -1) counts as unavailable -> next brain in the chain, not a whole-run failure. (4) a review-stage failure keeps the worktree branch so a rerun resumes instead of redoing finished tasks. Tests in tests/ for each. Then rerun #140.
